_readme: Special events that change what a park day is worth planning.
The ones that matter are hard-ticket nights: the park closes to day tickets
in the early evening and reopens for people holding a separate event ticket.
Plan a day to 10pm on one of those and the plan is wrong from about 6pm.
DATES ARE DELIBERATELY EMPTY. Operators publish them a few months ahead and
they change every year; inventing them would produce confident, wrong advice
of exactly the kind this product exists to avoid. With `dates` empty a park
shows a soft seasonal warning telling the visitor to check the official
calendar. Fill `dates` with confirmed ISO dates from the operator and the
same event becomes precise: the planner caps the day at closesEarlyAt and
Fields: name, kind (hard-ticket | seasonal), months (1-12 the event runs in),
closesEarlyAt (hour day tickets must leave, null if the park keeps normal
hours), note, dates (confirmed ISO dates, [] until filled).

magic-kingdom.name: Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party
magic-kingdom.note: Runs on selected nights. The party needs its own ticket and day tickets are asked to leave in the early evening.

magic-kingdom.name: Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party
magic-kingdom.note: Runs on selected nights, separate ticket, day guests out in the early evening.

california-adventure.name: Oogie Boogie Bash
california-adventure.note: Selected nights, sells out well in advance, and the park closes to day tickets before it starts.

epcot.name: EPCOT festival season
epcot.note: EPCOT runs a festival for most of the year. No separate ticket and normal hours, but weekends draw noticeably heavier crowds around World Showcase.

cedar-point.name: HalloWeekends
cedar-point.note: Included with admission, but the park often runs weekend-only operating days late in the season — check the calendar before travelling midweek.

alton-towers.name: Scarefest
alton-towers.note: Included with admission. Scare mazes are usually a separate add-on and hours differ from the rest of the season.

thorpe-park.name: Fright Nights
thorpe-park.note: Included with admission, mazes often a paid add-on, and the park runs later than usual.

europa-park.name: Halloween season
europa-park.note: Included with admission. Expect heavier weekends and different closing times.

universal-studios-florida.name: Halloween Horror Nights
universal-studios-florida.note: Selected nights. Separate ticket, and the park clears day guests before the event opens.

universal-studios-hollywood.name: Halloween Horror Nights
universal-studios-hollywood.note: Selected nights, separate ticket, day guests out beforehand.
